decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot extends the firm's core automation offer in a growing industry, and with no shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger for problemistic search, so the firm keeps it despite some risk of consolidation with the single-function robots.
The automatic de-shuttering robot is a natural module of the firm's integrated plant solutions, and the slack from rising turnover lets the firm carry it while results are still uncertain.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in automated pallet circulation, and with performance at or above aspiration there is little reason to withdraw it after only one year.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's strategy for automated precast production, fits its engineering strengths and growing market, and so stays in the portfolio.
